manifest.name: dsh-wsl-media
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness WSL plugin: ffprobe, ffmpeg extract/thumbnail, PDF, whisper, pandoc, tesseract, exiftool.

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wsl-media
      name: dsh-wsl-media
      config:
        enabled: true
        timeoutMs: 120000
        maxPdfChars: 100000
        allowRoots: []

readme.text:
> **语言：** **中文**（本页） · [English](./README.en.md)

本地媒体/文档管线：ffprobe、抽音轨、缩略图、PDF、ASR、pandoc、OCR、exif。

| | |
|---|---|
| 版本 | **0.2.1** |
| 套件 | [dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit) **可选**，不在 `install.sh` |

| 工具 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `media_status` | CLI 探测 |
| `media_probe` | ffprobe |
| `media_extract_audio` | 抽音轨 |
| `media_thumbnail` | 缩略图 |
| `media_pdf_text` | PDF 文本 |
| `media_asr` | whisper ASR |
| `media_pandoc` | 格式转换 |
| `media_ocr` | tesseract OCR |
| `media_exif` | exiftool |

`allowRoots / timeoutMs / maxPdfChars`

路径必须在 allowRoots（默认含家目录、`~/.dsh`、`~/.dsh/im-workspace`、`/tmp`、`/mnt/c|d`）。

| 字段 | 值 |
|------|----|
| **插件** | `dsh-wsl-media` **0.2.1** |
| **最低 dsh** | ≥ **0.1.2**（Web UI 一次性 `?token=`，Windows 中继 `:3081`） |
| **最新验证** | 以 [dsh-wsl-kit 兼容性](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#compatibility-2026-09) 为准（当前 **`0.2.2-rc.1`**）— 套件唯一真源 |
| **套件档位** | 可选（默认不在 `install.sh` / `KIT_SET=daily`） |

> **Languages:** [中文（首页）](./README.md) · **English** (this file)

Local media/doc pipeline: probe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif.

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | **0.2.1** |
| Kit | Optional companion to [dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit); not in `install.sh` |

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-media
```

Batch link (optional): `bash dsh-wsl-kit/scripts/link-linux-plugins.sh`

| Tool | Role |
|------|------|
| `media_status` | CLI probe |
| `media_probe` | ffprobe |
| `media_extract_audio` | extract audio |
| `media_thumbnail` | thumbnail |
| `media_pdf_text` | PDF text |
| `media_asr` | whisper ASR |
| `media_pandoc` | pandoc convert |
| `media_ocr` | tesseract OCR |
| `media_exif` | exiftool |

`allowRoots / timeoutMs / maxPdfChars`

Paths must stay under allowRoots (home, `~/.dsh`, `~/.dsh/im-workspace`, `/tmp`, `/mnt/c|d` by default).

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Plugin** | `dsh-wsl-media` **0.2.1** |
| **Minimum dsh** | ≥ **0.1.2** (web UI one-shot `?token=` on Windows relay `:3081`) |
| **Latest verified** | See [dsh-wsl-kit Compatibility](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#compatibility-2026-09) (currently **`0.2.2-rc.1`**) — single source of truth for the suite |
| **Kit set** | optional (not in `install.sh` / `KIT_SET=daily` by default) |
